title: Aliquotting PCR Primer Mixture
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yb7fsrn

steps.title: Prepare primer stock solutions
steps.instruction: Create the primer stocks by first adding nuclease‑free water to each primer tube as specified in the primer documentation (e.g., the volumes listed for E. coli K12) and then preparing 25 µM, 100 µL stocks according to the provided table.

substeps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to each tube as per the primer’s documentation (e.g., E. coli K12 volumes).
Make 25 µM, 100 µL primer stocks using the supplied table.

steps.title: Store primer mixtures
steps.instruction: Place all prepared primer mixtures in a freezer and store them for up to 2 years.

steps.title: Aliquot primers for daily use
steps.instruction: Aliquot the frozen primer mixture into amounts that can be used within a single day to avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.
